idea-plugin.name: Better Oceanic Next
idea-plugin.description:
Better Oceanic Next — a dark theme for JetBrains IDEs, ported from the Better Oceanic Next VS Code theme (based on Dainty – Oceanic Next).

Includes the full UI theme and a matching editor color scheme. Select it under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme. The editor colors are also available standalone under Settings | Editor | Color Scheme.
